dossier.summary: Tidewater Clinics runs nine urgent care sites along the Gulf Coast with a shared pool of nurses and physician assistants, and opened two more sites this year.
dossier.why_now: Opened two new sites this year, bringing the total to eleven by December.

data.booth_note: The scheduling board running on a full week of shifts across eleven sites, and two of us there to walk through it with your own rota if you bring it.

booth_hours.who: Lena Fischer and Omar Haddad, all day
Omar Haddad all day, Lena from 1:00 pm

talk.title: Staffing eleven clinic sites from one pool without a spreadsheet
talk.speaker: Lena Fischer, Kitewire

side_events.title: Healthcare operations happy hour
side_events.note: Clinic and practice operators only, about sixty people last year. Easy to find us there.

side_events.title: Breakfast for multi-site clinic operators
side_events.note: Sixteen seats, one topic: keeping a shared staff pool fair across sites. Ask Lena for a seat.

side_events.title: Urgent care growth panel
side_events.note: Three operators on how they opened sites without losing the people they already had.

side_events.title: Closing coffee at the stand
side_events.note: The last hour before the hall closes is the quietest. Good time for a proper look.

data.why_now: Opened two new sites this year, bringing the total to eleven by December.
data.personal_line: Eleven urgent care sites by December means the rota that worked for nine is about to break. Our stand runs the scheduling board live on a full week of shifts, so twenty minutes is enough to tell whether it fits how Tidewater shares staff across sites.
